en.heroTitle: Vermicompost for Polyhouse Vegetables — Tomato, Capsicum & Cucumber
en.heroLead: Protected cultivation needs stable organic matter in beds and media. Satva vermicompost supports tomato, capsicum, cucumber, leafy crops, and flowers in polyhouses across Punjab, Haryana, UP, and North India.

sectionsBeforeTable.title: Why Polyhouse Soil & Media Need Vermicompost
paragraphs: Polyhouse crops grow in concentrated root zones with frequent irrigation and fertigation. Mature vermicompost improves structure, moisture balance, and microbial life without the burn risk of raw manure.
Use at bed preparation, in planting holes, or mixed into potting media. Quality matters: unfinished compost can introduce pests or ammonia stress in closed structures.

table.title: Suggested Application in Protected Cultivation
rows: At transplant; repeat every 45–60 days if needed
table.intro: Adjust to your media mix and crop cycle. Contact us for commercial polyhouse programmes.

faqs.question: Can I use vermicompost with drip fertigation?
faqs.answer: Apply vermicompost to soil or media, not through drip lines. Solid organic manure belongs in the root zone, not the fertigation tank.

faqs.question: How do I avoid pests from compost in a polyhouse?
faqs.answer: Use well-matured, screened compost from a consistent supplier. Satva batches are pathogen-controlled and packed for farm use.

faqs.question: Do you supply near Mohali / Chandigarh?
faqs.answer: Yes. We are based in Mohali and serve Punjab, Haryana, and nearby polyhouse clusters with quick coordination.
